title: Choose Full15 source features
description: Build openSynth with your chosen Synth shortcut and optional global PC recorder.
introduction: Keep the native Synth chooser or select a Synth shortcut. Add the optional global recorder to capture screens, controls and USB audio on your computer.
planningNote: This source preview does not produce installable firmware. Native launch and hardware qualification remain incomplete.
targetNote: This catalog is separate from the Full14 core/global and historical P6S selections.
featureNote: Select Synth, then add the optional global recorder if wanted. Capture starts from the PC; the Synth shortcut remains configurable.
releaseScope: The first release focuses on Synth, global recording and USB updates. Autotune and stem splitting are planned for later.
shortcutNote: Chooser preserves native routing. Selecting a chord is your explicit choice to use that combination for Synth; press the final control last and release every control to rearm.
samplerShortcutScope: Requested scope: idle sampler/Generator lifecycle. This does not require audio transport to stop. Press the final control last, then release all controls to rearm.
normalUiShortcutScope: Requested preview scope: normal sampler, pattern, FX or utility screens. These screen restrictions have not been verified on the SP yet. The scope says nothing about USB audio transport.
unregisteredShortcutScope: No shortcut scope is registered for this feature.
shortcutLimit: Use two or three mapped buttons or pads for Synth. DEL, EXIT and SHIFT + PAD 13 remain reserved. The recorder starts on the PC and has no hardware shortcut.
emptyShortcuts: Select a feature above to choose its shortcut.
emptySummary: No features selected. Choose a feature to start a configuration.
memoryNote: Your selected features compile locally. The resulting module cannot be installed on the SP yet.
receiptNote: Choose a local JSON receipt to compare it with your current choices. Only metadata is checked; firmware files and device results remain unverified.
receiptLimit: JSON, up to 128 KiB. This check does not connect to your SP.
saved: Full15 source choices saved in this browser.
storageUnavailable: Browser storage is unavailable. Export your configuration to keep it.
transferNote: The local helper builds a module and its source receipt. It sends no firmware to the SP.
transferLimit: This recipe emits a source module and config receipt. Firmware installation remains disabled.
recordingNote: The optional global source route supplies OLED frames and control events to the PC recorder, which combines them with existing stereo USB audio. Host fixtures and P6S synth takes provide scoped recording evidence; whole-SP global capture still needs hardware testing.
noScript: Enable JavaScript to edit, import or export a configuration. The feature status and update limits are available below.
footer: Full15 source features. No device connection.
